RL02.P2.statement: Bounded local release packaging: clean committed source plus pinned SDK/profile inputs and an external protected RSA4096 key produce separately signed device PRG and real SDK IQ. Production candidate preserves reserved UUID/SpaceFoxApp and committed public fingerprint; qualification uses an unrelated UUID and disposable external key. Retain exact source/generated inputs, package and public signing provenance; reject wrong keys/identity, unqualified subsets, dirty or changed inputs, unsafe output, overwrite and cryptographic tamper. Official mode requires explicit hash-bound external backup/restore declarations; tool never infers real custody or Store readiness.
